body.statement: Let \(r=(r_0,\ldots,r_{K-1})\) and \(s=(s_0,\ldots,s_{K-1})\) be probability vectors on \(\{0,\ldots,K-1\}\), and put \(\Delta_j=\sum_{k=j}^{K-1}(r_k-s_k)\). Among all couplings \((U,V)\) with respective marginals \(r\) and \(s\), the sharp lower and upper bounds on \(P(U>V)\) are \(\max_{0\le j<K}\Delta_j\) and \(1+\min_{0\le j<K}(\Delta_j-r_j)\), respectively.

source.locator: Section 3.1, Proposition 2, equation (6), p. 546; notation for \(\Delta_j\) in equation (1), p. 543
source.verbatim_statement: Proposition 2: The sharp lower and upper bounds of \(\eta\) are \(\eta_L=\max_{0\le j\le J-1}\Delta_j\), \(\eta_U=1+\min_{0\le j\le J-1}(\Delta_j-p_{j+})\).
